debug_name: Selva surface (outdoor wake-zone + colle + chapel exterior)
_comment: First scene. Today this contains the chapel mesh inline; the asset split (crypt_exterior.glb + crypt_interior.glb) happens in a later step. For now the same crypt.glb is loaded here so the game looks identical to pre-Scenes state.
_terrain_modifiers_note: Chapel plateau + stair shaft hole modifiers are STILL registered via crypt_layout::registerChapelTerrainModifiers() in main.cpp BEFORE initTerrain(), because terrain is a global singleton today. When terrain becomes scene-local, modifier declarations move into this JSON.

triggers._comment: Player walks into the chapel through the front door. Door is at chapel-local Y = -BODY_LENGTH/2 - PLINTH_PROJECTION ≈ -4.05, chapel center at (0, -210); world Z = -210 + 4 = -206 for the door's front face. Trigger sits just inside the door so the player has stepped onto the threshold before the transition fires.
